SVF-1.notes: The panel prints SVF; the model slug is SVF-1. The plugin README says the filters use an IIR or FIR antialiasing filter, but fir.cpp is never referenced by any filter core in this version — only IIRLowpass is instantiated, so the decimation is always IIR. Cutoff is held as a normalised integration rate rather than a frequency (SVF.cpp:90 maps the knob to 0.001 to 2.251, svfilter.cpp:171 scales it by 44100 over the working rate), so no cutoff in hertz can be quoted from the source. The resonance sign flip is svfilter.cpp:223, fb = 1 - 3.5 * Resonance.

SKF.notes: SKF.cpp:68 calls configInput(OUTPUT_OUTPUT, "Filter") where configOutput was meant. OUTPUT_OUTPUT is zero, so the name lands on input 0 — the FM jack, whose own name from :65 is overwritten — and the OUT jack is left with no name at all. Rack therefore shows Filter when you hover FM and nothing when you hover OUT. Confirmed in the census: SKF is the only model in the plugin whose inputs[0] is named Filter and whose outputs[0] name is empty. Resonance is sallenkey.cpp:236, res = 4.0f * Resonance. The core also carries an SK_HIGHPASS_MODE and two further integration methods (SK_SEMI_IMPLICIT_EULER, SK_PREDICTOR_CORRECTOR) that the panel and menu never reach.

DDLY.notes: The buffer is DDLY_MAX_DELAY_TIME, defined as 3, times the sample rate, reallocated in onAdd. The time knob is cubed at DDLY.cpp:250 and elsewhere and floored at 0.0004 of the buffer. The write head at DDLY.cpp:355 computes hp - hp_input, which is the negative of the high-passed signal, so the buffer holds an inverted copy; it looks like a sign slip rather than a design choice, and it is described in the lines as what it does rather than as a fault. The clock ratio table is the sixteen values 0.125 to 2.0 at DDLY.cpp:185. The two CV jacks in the left column carry no printed label on the panel; their tooltips are Time CV and Feedback CV. sumRange on the time CV is the clip at DDLY.cpp:151, a normalised 0 to 1 of the buffer rather than a voltage; it is spelled in the only form the field allows.
